notes: dc.html p15 section-card shell (used by every section card on this page, including Notifications): `background:#fff;border:1px solid rgba(0,0,0,.12);border-radius:10px;box-shadow:0 1px 2px rgba(26,26,26,.04),0 4px 14px rgba(26,26,26,.06);overflow:hidden`, topped by the ruling 5.1 gradient rule `height:3px;background:linear-gradient(90deg,#5A5552,#5A5552 22%,rgba(90,85,82,.18))`. Artboard and ruling agree here exactly, nothing to reconcile.

dc.html p15 header row: `padding:14px 16px 10px;border-bottom:1px solid rgba(0,0,0,.08)`, title 'Notifications' `font-family:'Anton';text-transform:uppercase;letter-spacing:.04em;font-size:20px`, meta 'In-app now · email and push coming' `font-size:10.5px;color:#7A6E6C;font-weight:600` (two font-weight declarations on the same rule in the source; the later one, 600, is what a browser applies and what this spec measures against).

dc.html p15 toggle row: `min-height:48px;border-bottom:1px solid rgba(0,0,0,.06)`, label bold, sublabel `font-size:11px;color:#7A6E6C`; pill `width:32px;height:18px;border-radius:999px`, knob `width:14px;height:14px` inset 2px.

The real built shell, `src/components/account/AccountPrimitives.tsx`'s `AccountCard`, has NO gradient-rule element at all (its section renders straight into a header div, no 3px bar first-child) — the 'gradient rule' child target below is deliberately a broad `section > div` narrowed by `matchStyle` (README's own recommended technique for 'an element the product gives no marker attribute to'), so a genuinely absent rule reports NOT BUILT rather than a false MISMATCH against the header div sitting in that position.

The real `AccountCard` wrapper is the shared shell for this section AND the Account 'Members & roles' section (see account-members.json) — one spec file per section per this lane's PARTS list ('account/settings ... including ... the Notifications section'), same underlying component.
